subject: Stakeholder roadmap & quick-win MAP for pilot
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@tidalhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Li <aaron.li@tidalhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder roadmap & quick-win MAP for pilot

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the approach to data isolation. We want to move from research to a short pilot focused on two quick wins: triage summarization for intake forms, and an embeddings-based search for the clinician KB.

Can you share a concise MAP template we can use to align stakeholders (clinical ops, security, and platform) and a suggested 4–6 week evaluation timeline? Our procurement and security teams will want explicit acceptance criteria and an audit trail for any data sent to a hosted endpoint.

High level asks from our side:
- Short MAP template (doc) we can co-edit
- Pilot acceptance criteria (privacy + perf thresholds)
- Proposed close / decision timeframe (we're aiming to decide by end of Q3)

Happy to sync Friday morning PT if that helps.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Clinical Operations
Tidal Health

--
Attachment: intake-sample.csv (text/csv)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 12:15:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder roadmap & quick-win MAP for pilot

Samira — appreciate the clarity and the use cases. Attaching a starter MAP and a short slide deck for week1 kickoff. I also put together an acceptance checklist for the two quick wins so your security and procurement folks have concrete items to review.

Quick notes:
- Link to editable MAP doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAPstarter (we'll keep a revision history)
- Starter MAP file attached: MAP_quickwin_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub)
- Acceptance checklist attached: eval_acceptance_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
- Week1 slides attached: pilot-week1-slides.pptx (pptx stub)

Proposed 5-week evaluation cadence (can compress or expand):
1) Week 0: alignment & access (roles, endpoint access, data samples)
2) Week 1: technical validation + perf baseline (latency, throughput)
3) Week 2–3: integration & sample workflows (triage summaries)
4) Week 4: acceptance testing against checklist
5) Week 5: decision review & next steps (canary or scale)

If it helps, we can add a small column in the MAP for "evidence" links (logs, screenshots) so auditors can quickly find artifacts.

I can host a 30-minute sync Friday 9:30am PT with Marissa and Olga to walk through the doc. Would that work?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0176

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:02:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder roadmap & quick-win MAP for pilot

On Wed, Aug 26, 2026 at 12:15 PM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samira — appreciate the clarity and the use cases. Attaching a starter MAP and a short slide deck for week1 kickoff.

Thanks Diego — adding a few pragmatic acceptance criteria explicitly for procurement/security to make reviews faster. Samira, below are items we typically see close the loop quickly with enterprise security reviewers: 

- Data residency statement (we can list which fields are sent to hosted inference)
- Redaction checklist (PII fields removed or hashed)
- Perf SLA goals: median latency < 200ms for summary endpoint on 256-token sequences; 95th < 750ms under pilot load
- Audit artifacts: token-level request logs (anonymized), model version pinned in MAP, and test inputs used for acceptance

I've attached a short acceptance checklist you can hand to your security reviewer: eval_acceptance_checklist.xlsx. I also added an "owner" column in the MAP doc and a short stakeholder RACI so we know who signs off.

Diego — confirmed for Friday 9:30am PT. I'll lead the walkthrough and highlight the security artifacts.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: eval_acceptance_checklist.xlsx
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@tidalhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder roadmap & quick-win MAP for pilot

Diego / Marissa — thank you, this is exactly the level of granularity our audit team needs. I've forwarded the MAP doc and checklist to Aaron (platform) and Priya (security) for pre-review. We aim to run the pilot the week of Sept 13 pending access.

Two small asks before Friday:
1) Can you add a sample redacted request/response (anonymized) to the MAP under "evidence" so Priya can see exactly what we will log?
2) If the latency numbers above are median/95th under pilot load, can you call out the model variant and quantization profile you plan to run for the pilot?

If you can drop those into the doc before our call it will speed the approval. Looking forward to the walkthrough Friday 9:30am PT.

Best,
Samira
